[bṛhatkathāmañjarī(kādambarī)]
[by Bāṇa Bhaṭṭa. Adyar II. p. 16]. This contains a brief anuṣṭubh resume of the story of Kādambarī which is different from what is found in Br. k. m. of Kṣemendra an. KSS. of Somadeva. It ends thus: iyameva kathA bhaTTabANena bahulIkRtA | kAdambarIkRtitvena vidvanmaNimude kSitau || vRhatkathAmaJjarIti nAmnA khyAtA mahAkRtiH | bhaTTabANena racitA jIyAdrasikaharSadA ||

[Bṛhatkathāmañjarī(kādambarī)]
by Bāṇa Bhaṭṭa; a brief metrical resume of Kādambarī. Adyar II. p. 1b. Adyar D.
